page.content:
22 June 1941 — German invasion of the Soviet Union.

How Operation Barbarossa connects

  • Character: Adolf Hitler — Hitler ordered the invasion of the Soviet Union.
  • Character: Joseph Stalin — Stalin's state absorbed and then reversed Barbarossa.
  • Event: Battle of Stalingrad — Stalingrad was the later turning point of the war Barbarossa began.

What is Operation Barbarossa?

Barbarossa opened the eastern war of annihilation. Early encirclements did not take Moscow; the front became the grave of the Wehrmacht.

Key threads lead to Adolf Hitler, Joseph Stalin and Battle of Stalingrad.
